name: netroll-email-build
description: Build-time MJML -> HTML compiler for NetRoll's transactional email templates. Deliberately a SEPARATE manifest from frontend/: keeping mjml out of frontend/package.json keeps it out of the SPA's `npm sbom` (deploy.yml) and out of the image build's `npm ci` (Containerfile), so no Node mail tooling reaches the runtime image. Its tree is still audited — ci.yml's required `audit` job runs `npm audit` here too.
